--!nonstrict
-- Optional native comparison page; the application supplies its window manager.
local Common=require(script.Parent.Parent.Pages.Common)
return function(manager)
	return {Route='windows',Title='Windows and dialogs',Icon='page',Description='Window shadows, owned windows, modal messages and controls.',Keywords={'window','dialog','error','shadow','snap'},
		Render=function(ctx)
			local page=Common.page(ctx,'Windows and dialogs','The imported window system runs inside the standalone WindowManager module.')
			local intro=Common.text(ctx.Controls,page.Content,'Move or resize a sample window. Bring another window forward to compare active and inactive shadows. Drag to a screen edge for the snap preview.',14,true)
			local status=Common.text(ctx.Controls,page.Content,'No dialog result yet.',14)
			local buttons={}
			local function result(name)
				if page.Alive then status.Text='Last result: '..name;page:Reflow()end
			end
			for _,item in {{'Information','info','OK'},{'Warning','warning','OKCancel'},{'Error','error','RetryCancel'},{'Question','question','YesNoCancel'}}do
				table.insert(buttons,Common.button(ctx.Controls,page.Content,item[1],nil,function()
					manager:MessageBox({Title=item[1],Message='This is a '..item[2]..' dialog. The owning window stays visible and becomes available again when this dialog closes.',
						Icon=item[2],Buttons=item[3],OnResult=result})
				end))
			end
			table.insert(buttons,Common.button(ctx.Controls,page.Content,'Application modal',nil,function()
				manager:MessageBox({Title='Application modal',Message='This message has no owner. Other managed windows remain blocked until it closes.',Icon='info',Owner=false,OnResult=result})
			end))
			table.insert(buttons,Common.button(ctx.Controls,page.Content,'Open sample window',nil,function()
				local window=manager:Open({Title='Sample window',Owner=manager:GetFocused(),Size=Vector2.new(440,290)})
				manager.Gui:Make('TextLabel',window.Content,{Text='Try the title bar, the eight resize edges, minimize, maximize, restore and close.\n\nThe window closes with its owner.',
					TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30),TextWrapped=true,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
					Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,20),Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,1,-40)})
			end))
			page.Layout=function(width)
				local height=Common.height(intro.Text,width,14);Common.place(intro,0,0,width,height)
				local columns=if width>=620 then 3 else 2
				local buttonWidth=(width-(columns-1)*12)/columns
				for index,button in buttons do Common.place(button.Root,((index-1)%columns)*(buttonWidth+12),height+20+math.floor((index-1)/columns)*56,buttonWidth,44)end
				local y=height+20+math.ceil(#buttons/columns)*56+12
				local resultHeight=Common.height(status.Text,width,14);Common.place(status,0,y,width,resultHeight)
				return y+resultHeight
			end
			page:Restore();return page
		end}
end
